messages:
Jordan (AE): Heads-up — AnthemBridge wants to start a 30-day POC but procurement paused signing. Two asks: vendor-signed HSM attestation in the DPA, and option to split the 3-month reserved commit into quarterly invoices if they convert. They prefer DocuSign routing to procurement + legal.
Marta (Legal): copy. can you paste the PO text or link? want to scan for audit/indemnity/termination hooks.
Jordan (AE): portal link: https://portal.redwood.ai/uploads/AB-PO-2026-301.pdf. PO summary pasted: 
```
PO#: AB-PO-2026-301
Amount: $36,000 (3-month reserved commit)
Instance: dedicated-4xA100
Billing: requested quarterly invoicing (they want invoice-at-term-start)
Security: require vendor-signed HSM attestation; DPA redline attached by customer
Signature: DocuSign to procurement@anthembridge.org + legal@anthembridge.org
```
I asked if POC will run in Dedicated — PM said Dedicated preferred.
Ike (Solutions): if Dedicated is confirmed we can offer BYO-KMS and HSM-backed keys which usually satisfies attestations. For Hosted the attestation wording is more limited. also suggest attaching a 1-page "POC BOM" (GPU hours, reserved vs burst, monitoring credits, short SLA bullets) — procurement likes that.
Sahil (Security): we have a standard HSM attestation template signed by infra. can provide SOC2 excerpt + KMS diagram. for a vendor-signed letter we need Legal to add a one-page attestation appendix to the DPA.
Marta (Legal): i'll draft the DPA redline and the HSM attestation addendum. also will tighten the subprocessors paragraph (notice + opt-out for non-essential). propose countersign window of 4 business days.
Priya (Finance): quarterly invoicing ok but need clarification: 3-month commit invoiced quarterly equals one upfront invoice. confirm whether they want invoice at term-start (prepay) or invoice after first month (postpay). prepay needs standard billing flow; postpay needs credit review. also suggest a $12k exposure cap during POC.
Jordan (AE): asked procurement to confirm invoice-at-term-start vs usage-start. they responded they prefer invoice-at-term-start. procurement also asked for SLA bullets (p95 latency, uptime target, escalation contact).
redwood-bot: infra-note: dedicated-4xA100 us-west-2 pool spare capacity: 16% for next 7 days.
Ike (Solutions): i'll assemble the 1-page POC BOM + short SLA excerpt (p95 latency, 99.5% uptime, fallback model) and attach it to the orderform — usually helps procurement approve.
Sahil (Security): i'll upload the attestation pdf and KMS architecture snippet once Marta confirms the addendum language.
Marta (Legal): action items: 1) i'll post DPA redline + HSM addendum to the portal by EOD. 2) propose countersign ETA 4 business days; include escalation contact if delayed.
Priya (Finance): action: will approve quarterly invoice flow once PO pdf and invoice-at-term-start confirmed; will set the $12k exposure cap while POC runs.
Jordan (AE): i'll confirm DocuSign signer emails and request countersign within 5 business days on their side. will paste signer emails here when received.
Ike (Solutions): FYI, if they later want a Dedicated private deployment (BYO-KMS) we can include language for customer-managed keys in the addendum.
Jordan (AE): procurement just sent signer emails (procurement@anthembridge.org, legal@anthembridge.org). requested DocuSign and countersign within 5 business days.
Marta (Legal): noted. i'll include signer emails in the DocuSign envelope and upload the DPA redline + addendum once drafted.
Sahil (Security): attaching attestation in a follow-up thread after Legal posts addendum language.
Priya (Finance): will queue billing ticket once PO pdf and invoice cadence confirmed.
Jordan (AE): thanks team — i'll close this thread for now and reopen if procurement pushes additional redlines. please @me when DPA redline and POC BOM are uploaded. :thumbsup:
